<script lang="ts">
import type { Variants } from 'motion-v'
import type { IconProps } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'

export type ClockArrowUpProps = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

export const animations = {
  default: {
    face1: {},
    arrow: {
      initial: { y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' } },
      animate: { y: -1, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' } },
    },
    path1: {},
    path2: {},
    minute: {
      initial: {
        rotate: 0,
        transformOrigin: '50% 100%',
        transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeInOut' },
      },
      animate: {
        rotate: 360,
        transformOrigin: '50% 100%',
        transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeInOut' },
      },
    },
    hour: {
      initial: {
        rotate: 0,
        transformOrigin: '0% 0%',
        transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeInOut' },
      },
      animate: {
        rotate: [0, 20, 0],
        transformOrigin: '0% 0%',
        transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeInOut' },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
} as const;
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { IconWrapper } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'
import { motion } from 'motion-v'

defineOptions({ name: 'ClockArrowUp', inheritAttrs: false })
</script>

<template>
  <IconWrapper
    v-slot="{ variants, controls, size, attrs }"
    :animations="animations"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  >
    <motion.svg

      :height="size"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="2"

      <motion.g

        :animate="controls"
      >
        <motion.path
          d="m14 18 4-4 4 4"
          :variants="variants.path1"
          initial="initial"
          :animate="controls"
        />
        <motion.path
          d="M18 22v-8"
          :variants="variants.path2"
          initial="initial"
          :animate="controls"
        />
      </motion.g>
      <motion.path
        d="M12 6V12"
        :variants="variants.minute"

        :animate="controls"
      />
      <motion.path
        d="M12 12L13.56 12.78"
